locations.name: Highbreaker Road
locations.blurb: The alpine road down from Galross Pass. Riders and travelers on foot use it in good weather, but weather, rockslides, and predators make it a real risk.

locations.name: River Road
locations.blurb: Follows the north bank of the Raven River past the Vayne estate and farmsteads toward Gor-Uk and the Hen's Teeth. Firm enough for wool carts and grain wagons.

locations.name: Steading Road
locations.blurb: Leaves through the Farm Gate to the northeastern homesteads. Past the last farm it narrows to a rough trail into the blighted land.

locations.name: Coastal Road
locations.blurb: Runs out of the North Gate across tidal flats and open moor toward Gull Point, Cravenmoor, and Millesh Bay. A maintained, Crown-patrolled route.

locations.name: Godsfall Bay
locations.blurb: The upper reach of the great inlet of the Sea of Zephyrys that also receives the Godsfall River far to the south at Bridgeport.

locations.name: Galross Gate
locations.blurb: Heavy toll gate on the mountain road to Bridgeport, watched by guards in the burgomeister's livery of three black boar heads on gold and purple.

locations.name: North Gate
locations.blurb: Guards the Coastal Road from Cravenmoor and the wider duchy. Most ducal trade and taxes pass beneath its arch, and its watchtowers command the open moor.

locations.name: Farm Gate
locations.blurb: Where the town's main road continues to farms and the road toward Spelman's Bane. No toll is collected, and a barricade can be rolled shut at dusk.

locations.name: Orchard Gate
locations.blurb: A working gate for the farms and orchards south of the Raven River, closed with a rolling barricade at night. Inspections are light for returning locals.

locations.name: River Gate
locations.blurb: Opens onto the river road upstream toward Gor-Uk, the Numps of Mar, and the Hen's Teeth. Two watchtowers, one covering the road and one a narrow pier.

locations.name: Town Docks
locations.blurb: A staggered line of timber wharves and warehouses facing the tides. Larger ships anchor offshore and unload by lighter. Home to the Livestock House and the Excise Hall.

locations.name: Dalraven Fishery
locations.blurb: A broad timber complex at the north end of the docks where the day's catch is hauled ashore, sorted, cleaned, and sent to town. Run by the Fishermen's Compact.

locations.name: Blackshore Saltworks
locations.blurb: A broad, low complex of sheds, brick ovens, brine pans, and smokehouses that cures fish and pork for export and keeps the town stocked through lean months.

locations.name: Gull & Gaff Tavern
locations.blurb: A three-story waterfront tavern at the corner of the coastal road and the main street from the bridge. Loud, dependable, and the likeliest place in town to rent a riding horse.

locations.name: Grey Ghost Hammersmiths
locations.blurb: A broad timber-and-stone smithy across from the docks, with racks of mundane arms out front and a large forge hall behind. Run by the Ursinor Grey-Ghost twins.

locations.name: Dalraven Market
locations.blurb: An open market near the center of town. Three rows of open-faced shops angle in toward a shared court, with sailcloth canopies that can be drawn across against squalls.

locations.name: Guard Hall
locations.blurb: A squat, solid stone building on a side street behind the Moot Hall, with a muster hall, armory, small holding cell, and training yard.

locations.name: Dalraven Moot Hall
locations.blurb: The town's administrative seat, with a square bell tower rising above the rooftops. It holds the assembly chamber, tax office, records, vault, and gaol.

locations.name: Crown Garrison
locations.blurb: A walled compound against the northern wall with barracks, a training yard, and cavalry stables. Two platoons of Algar Crown Cavaliers are based here, one usually out on patrol.

locations.name: Irontrail Outfitters
locations.blurb: Dalraven's main supplier for anyone heading out of town: rope, canvas, bedrolls, rations, traps, and charts, with a corner for buying hunters' pelts and curiosities.

locations.name: Riverwake Inn
locations.blurb: Dalraven's largest inn, three stories of timber over stone near the bridge, with a lantern-strung patio facing the river and sea. Much of the top floor is leased to hired blades.

locations.name: Petal & Pestle
locations.blurb: A timber-framed shop wrapped in ivy and blossoms, with a fogged glass greenhouse behind. The gnome herbalist sells remedies and trades for rare plants.

locations.name: Blackwind Ciderworks
locations.blurb: A tall coastal windmill that powers a cider press instead of grinding grain. Its sails are a landmark from the sea, and its barrels are known along the coast.

locations.name: Ravenbank Fulling Mill
locations.blurb: A river-powered mill just beyond the bridge, where heavy wooden hammers clean, thicken, and strengthen woven wool before sale.

locations.name: Vaelthas Seaforth
locations.blurb: A long timber warehouse by the river and docks supplying barrels, rigging, sail and net repairs, and occasionally a small riverboat for hire. Run by an elf from Silmar.

locations.name: House of Bounty
locations.blurb: A timber-and-pale-stone temple of Charr, Eternal of Birth, Fertility, Nature, and Agriculture. It serves as both sanctuary and the town's communal hall.

locations.name: Shrine of the Deep Current
locations.blurb: A plain, windworn ring of stones and a tide-carved altar near the east wall, rebuilt inland after a storm destroyed the original. Tended by Tidewardens.

locations.name: Ravenbridge
locations.blurb: A broad timber trestle bridge, wide enough for wagons, that links the walled town to its southern fringe and farmlands. Only small craft pass beneath.

locations.name: Ashborne Estate
locations.blurb: One of the oldest and largest landholdings in the duchy: grain fields, orchards, upland pastures, an inland windmill, and a private dock on the river.

locations.name: Vayne Manor
locations.blurb: The marble-faced home of Burgomeister Halric Vayne, on a rise above the River Road in a wooded park with a private river dock, a guest house, and farmland beyond.
